verdict.rationale: Claude Design exports designs to open formats (HTML, PDF, PPTX), and a community report says the account data export includes Claude Design chats and code in a design_chats directory even after access is lost. However, users report losing access to their projects after unsubscribing, and a Claude team member acknowledged this and only promised a fix. SVG export also strips animations unless you rename the file to work around it. Missing for 10: a documented first-party bulk export of all projects, guaranteed access to export after cancelling, and lossless export (e.g. SVG animations).
